spec_acceptance.criterion: **Reference and route evidence.** Record the actual reference URL/backend/error behavior, NTS's published exact NTS 1/2 URLs, and dated redirect/status/content-type observations for both channels. Distinguish the owner client, direct HTTP, browser, and ChatGPT host evidence. Record the test profile and network vantage; do not claim global reliability.
spec_acceptance.evidence: Owner reference uses one redirect-following mpv backend with IPC paused/loading/error state and live recovery/rejoin. NTS's exact published URLs in the approved spec were each probed on 2026-11-13T00:50:36.205Z: relay 302 to streams.radiomast.io, 302 to the observed audio-edge host, then 200 audio/mpeg. Each final response provided at most 64 bytes with MP3 frame sync. This is one new network vantage/time and no global stability claim.
spec_acceptance.method: Read the local owner reference Model.js/Player.qml and approved route docs; performed fresh dated direct HTTP probes for both published URLs.

spec_acceptance.criterion: **Bounded in-app experiment.** NTS 1/2 selection and explicit Play/Pause/Play-again use the existing audio controller and coordination. The NTS media source is fixed to the two published URLs. The UI resource declares only the three currently observed NTS route origins in addition to its existing country origins; no wildcard, proxy, or `connectDomains` expansion. A changed or blocked destination yields an honest error and working official link. Automated checks cover exact URLs/CSP, selection and source switching, NTS not reporting Radio Browser clicks, Play/Pause/resume, error fallback, and existing country behavior.
spec_acceptance.evidence: Both selected official URLs use the existing single audio element/controller and coordinator; no country URL admission is loosened. The discovery resource adds only the three exact origins (country resourceDomains plus NTS origins; connectDomains empty). In headless Chromium, each channel independently produced its own matching-source loadedmetadata/canplay/playing, currentTime increase >0.1s, pause, then a new playing event on Play-again; each final network response was 200 audio/mpeg. Test suite covers mocked error fallback and working official link, NTS click/attribution isolation, source switching and stale guards. The browser fixture is synthetic and not an actual ChatGPT host.
spec_acceptance.method: Ran exact-candidate automated suite and a bounded local Chromium CDP fixture with separate fresh page/event log per channel; inspected controller, attribution, policy, and server integration tests.

spec_acceptance.criterion: **Independent candidate and host outcome.** Independent Review and Verify inspect the same candidate commit. Verify separately records direct HTTP route, local browser behavior if obtainable in a bounded run, and actual ChatGPT UI/CSP plus audible NTS 1 and NTS 2 Play, Pause, and Play-again, including an error path and coordination. Each layer may PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED based on its own evidence. If real host access or audible observation is missing, host playback and the overall technical outcome remain **BLOCKED**, even if code, HTTP checks, and local tests pass. A host failure is recorded as FAIL rather than represented as working playback.
spec_acceptance.evidence: Independent Review accepted this exact commit; direct and local browser layers passed as described. No actual ChatGPT MCP Apps host or audible observer was available, so actual host CSP and audible NTS 1/2 Play, Pause and Play-again plus host error/coordination/layout remain BLOCKED as required.
spec_acceptance.method: Bound review and verification to the same exact commit and separated direct-route, synthetic local-browser, and ChatGPT-host evidence.
